document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-convert.md` for the full workflow. Determine the converter from the input file extension: `.docx`→`docx2md`, `.md`→PDF/Word, `.pdf`→`pdf2md`, `.pptx`→Markdown/PDF, `.xlsx`→`xlsx2md`. Activate `.utils/.venv/` before running. Always run from the repository root.
